svg.title: Cross-engine GFN2-xTB energy and analytic-force latency
svg.desc: Three log-scale panels compare batch 1, 128, and 512 systems. Filled points are eligible: dependent points pass the declared output compatibility gate and tblite points provide its references. Hollow points fail the gate, and x marks unavailable coordinates.
